Correct motion vectors are essential for temporal stability.
Motion vectors are per-pixel screen-space displacements from the current frame to the previous frame.
For every pixel, the motion vector should answer the question, where was this pixel in the previous frame?
Motion vectors have been a staple of modern rendering technique.
Getting motion vectors right makes the difference between a blurry result and a sharp output under motion.
